build_DeformableDETR_model: build a DeformableDETR model with a backbone, transformer, and configurable number of object queries
run_DeformableDETR_forward: run the DeformableDETR forward pass on a NestedTensor of batched images to get predictions
create_MLP_module: create a multi-layer perceptron module with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
run_PostProcess_inference: run PostProcess to convert raw model outputs into COCO API format with scores, labels, and boxes
review_DeformableDETR_from_config: review the DeformableDETR from_config method to understand how Detectron2 config builds the model
